subject: world_language
concept: Unit review and mastery check confirming CEFR C2 (near-native proficiency) threshold, and full Grade 11 World Languages year-end review
source_inspiration: original content — cumulative review, not sourced from any single external curriculum

exercise.pictorial: Mixed set of implication/connotation and precise expression questions spanning nodes 01-07
exercise.abstract: Mixed register-adaptation, sophisticated writing, source synthesis, teaching, and capstone-project questions spanning nodes 01-07

assessment.mastery_threshold: 8/10 correct across mixed question types, plus a passing capstone project demonstrating C2-level proficiency
misconception_flags: any single-node misconception flag from 01-07 recurring at this stage

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
target_language: configurable — student/parent selects target language at enrollment
next_node_on_fail: WORLDLANG.G11.NATIVE_LIKE_PROFICIENCY.REVIEW (targeted remediation, routes to specific failed sub-node)
